rule: Create one run-specific artifact per gate outside this immutable directory. PASS requires the exact gate name, exact full-input hash, the complete gate-specific component hash set declared by the runner, a nonempty reproducible verification method, verifiedAt no later than authorization, and at least one unique evidence record with id/path/hash/time. The runner loads every evidence path from the same reachable remote commit, applies the path-traversal guard and recomputes its hash. Only researchCorpusSealed carries and attests the separate external researchCorpusSha256; the hash of this gate-attestation JSON remains an independent authenticity hash and never equals the corpus identity by rule.
